---
title: "Profile"
---

I am a hydrologist and water resources engineer with experience in hydrological modeling, hydroclimatic data analysis, streamflow forecasting, drought and flood monitoring, and climate services.

My work combines hydrological modeling, Earth observation, geomatics, and data science to develop operational tools and scientific products for water resources management in Peru.

## Current roles

- Researcher in Hydrology, National Service of Meteorlogy and Hydrology of Peru (SENAMHI), Peru.
- PhD candidate in Water Resources, National Agrarian University La Molina (UNALM), Peru.
- Lecturer, Master's Programme in Hydraulics, National University of Engineering (UNI), Peru.
- Lecturer, Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, University of Engineering and Technology (UTEC), Peru.

## Research interests

- Hydrological modeling and forecasting
- Flood and drought monitoring
- Climate services and hydroinformatics
- Hydrological regionalization and ungauged basins
- Hydroclimatic datasets and reproducible workflows
- Climate variability and change impacts on water resources


## Selected projects

- Climate change analysis in the influence area of the Las Bambas Mine Tailings Storage Facility.
- Characterizing patterns of spatio-temporal variability in snow properties through field and remotely sensed observations.
- Development of a hydrological forecasting model for the Huallaga River basin to support hydropower scheduling and operational decision-making.
- Development of national-scale hydrological modeling and forecasting products for Peru.
- Development of hydroclimatic datasets and reproducible tools for hydrological analysis.

## Education

- PhD candidate in Water Resources, Universidad Nacional Agraria La Molina, Peru.
- MSc in Water and Environmental Resources, Universidad Nacional Agraria La Molina, Peru.
- Agricultural Engineer, Universidad Nacional Agraria La Molina, Peru.
